data.name: Out West
data.detailed_description: Hitch a ride and embark on your journey alongside up to 8 players as you begin your excursion to California in search of fortune. Players must manage their hunger and thirst by scavenging, stealing, or hunting for supplies at different stops along the way to help them survive the long ride out west. Everyone wants to make it to California but the way in which you do so is up to you. You can work together as a group or stick solo and keep to yourself. Alliances may be made, trust may be betrayed, but the only thing that matters is making it to the gold.

data.short_description: A multiplayer survival game where trust and cooperation are everything. Travel with up to 8 players scavenging for supplies and deciding who is friend or foe. Every alliance is fragile. Every choice a gamble. Everyone wants to reach the gold, but do you have what it takes to get there?
